fold_scheme: 032: exclude HC43 first, then subject-level health-stratified shuffled 5-fold
perturbation_protocol: 3 fixed row-order seeds crossed with all 5 fold seeds; original b5/b2 protocol; independent train/public RNG streams, permutation within subject, inverse mapping to original rows
interpretation_rule: Report paired AUC drops descriptively; correlated repeats are not independent significance tests. Material mean drop >= 0.01 means protocol-sensitive exploration, not robust improvement. No tuning or public label feedback.
